verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents persistent browser sessions that keep cookies, storage, tabs and page state between operations, with VNC take-over. Its Python/TypeScript/REST SDK connects to cloud Chromium over CDP, which implies some programmatic session control. Nothing in the pack covers running many sessions in parallel or any concurrency caps. missing for 10: documented concurrency limits, evidence of running a concurrent fleet of sessions, explicit session lifecycle APIs (create/list/close), independent corroboration at scale.
